capabilities: Assign a 4-character code to every note
Look up notes by code in a search modal
Copy a note's code or obsidian://note-codes/open URL
Open notes by code via a protocol handler
Display the current note's code in the status bar or metadata sidebar
extras: Codes are derived from the note path via SHA-256 and Crockford Base32, so they change when a note is renamed; the README explains ambiguous characters are normalized during search.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to reference a note by a short identifier you can jot down on paper or type elsewhere, since paths and names are long and change on rename.
summary: Short-code linker that assigns a stable 4-character code to every note so you can reference and open notes from anywhere.
